results.text: Alternate-day dosing of atorvastatin: effects in treating type 2 diabetic patients with dyslipidaemia. An analysis is made of the effect of alternateday dosing of atorvastatin and standard once-daily dosing, based on mean low-density lipoprotein (LDL) reduction from baseline in type 2 diabetics. Forty-four type 2 diabetics were enrolled in the study.
